name: Battery_Rated_Capacity
description: Battery rated capacity (BMS firmware V27.52.3.0 or newer)

name: EMS_Battery_Power
description: RW: EMS battery power set point, negative = charge, positive = discharge (only in EMS battery control mode 771, see README)

name: EMS_Max_Grid_Injection
description: RW: EMS upper limit of inverter AC power (max. feed-in)

name: EMS_Max_Grid_Purchase
description: RW: EMS lower limit of inverter AC power, negative = max. grid purchase

name: EMS_Output_Priority
description: RW: EMS output priority 0=PV first, 1=battery first

name: Charge_Cutoff_SOC
description: RW: battery charge cutoff SOC (10.0-98.0, newer firmware only)

name: Charge_Current_Limit
description: RW: max. battery charge current (newer firmware only)

name: Discharge_Current_Limit
description: RW: max. battery discharge current (newer firmware only)
